title: RIGHT JOIN Suppliers with Products
description: Retrieve all products and their supplier information using RIGHT JOIN.

data.text: Write a query to list all products and their supplier names, including suppliers that have no products listed.

data.title: SQL Solution
data.code:
SELECT
    p.ProductID,
    p.ProductName,
    p.Price,
    s.SupplierName
FROM Products p
RIGHT JOIN Suppliers s ON p.SupplierID = s.SupplierID
ORDER BY s.SupplierName;

data.title: Explanation
data.text: RIGHT JOIN returns all rows from the right table (Suppliers) and matching rows from the left (Products). For suppliers with no products, the product columns will be NULL. RIGHT JOINs are less common — consider rewriting as LEFT JOIN by reversing table order.
